transcript.text: I've just bought an AEG L7FEE865R and the Eco 40-60 wash says 3:39 and seems to take forever. My old machine did a 40 wash in an hour. Is it faulty? Should I send it back?

It is not faulty and you do not need to send it back. The Eco 40-60 programme is designed to save energy by washing at lower temperatures for longer periods; a cycle time of around 3 hours and 40 minutes is standard for this setting. Your old machine likely used a different, faster programme that heats the water more aggressively or has less sophisticated load sensing. As long as the machine finishes the cycle and the clothes come out clean, it is working exactly as intended.

reading.symptom: Eco 40-60 wash takes 3:39 and seems to take forever

plan: They asked: "Is it faulty? Should I send it back?" - answer that first.
Already given by the customer, never ask for it again: make AEG; model L7FEE865R.
The fault they reported is: "Eco 40-60 wash takes 3:39 and seems to take forever". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply.
